setup.command: set -e; corepack enable; corepack prepare pnpm@10.26.0 --activate; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; missing=''; command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing="$missing postgresql"; command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing="$missing golang-go"; if [ -n "$missing" ]; then sudo apt-get update -qq; sudo apt-get install -y -qq $missing; fi

run.command: set -e; if [ "${RUNTIME_PREVIEW_MODE:-production}" = "dev" ]; then exec ./node_modules/.bin/next dev; fi; pnpm build; exec ./node_modules/.bin/next start
